notes.title: Find the Gnome 2 now available
notes.content:
Find the Gnome 2 is now available to Wishlist. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855160/Find_the_Gnome_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855160/Find_the_Gnome_2/[/url]

The same gnomes, but with everything else improved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32442792/2f77ce6b6cda20ef4b252cde8e9ed8736d95fa63.png[/img]

Discover many different environments, interact with almost all the objects in the environment, find all the achievements, listen to the ambiance music, watch the parallax comics. There is so much to do!

Important note: The update that was announced earlier 'that I would update the existing Find the Gnome game', is not accurate anymore. Long story short: the upgrade became too different from the existing one, so a new store page is only fitting for such a nice new game.

notes.title: Massive update incoming
notes.content:
My games receive love, tender and care even after a long time. That is why I am putting time and effort in updating this game, instead of releasing a new one.

Find the Gnome is getting a massive overhaul that will address all the issues with the 'old' version, and will massively improve the game-play.
[list]
[*][b]Keep the good[/b]. Click, interact, look carefully, spot the gnomes you need to catch.
[*]However, now with [b]more diverse gameplay[/b]. Some gnomes walk around, other gnomes hide in objects that you can interact with. You have to interact with the environment to 'open up' the level. Complete objectives and find hidden secrets.
[*]And [b]visual consistency[/b]. Fully hand modeled by me in the low poly artistic style.
[*]And [b]Improved sounds and music[/b]. With ambient music to accompany you during your play-through.
[*]And [b]a free moving camera[/b], as requested.
[*]And [b]more diverse content[/b]. The first version will ship with 3 unique levels with already more content then the 'old' version had. More levels will be added in the coming months with each update also adding more to find in the earlier released levels.
[/list]

The game currently is in beta testing. This is beta for the version that will release in approximately 8 weeks.

That's it for now folks!

notes.title: Complete overhaul comming?!
notes.content:
I am currently working on a new title. However as you might have noticed my art skills aren't that great. the current installment of 'Find the Gnome' does show this of nicely (pun intended). So I need to put in the hours to get my art skills to a higher level.

As a practice I will be working on 'Find the Gnome':
[list]
[*]Give it improved visuals: A full low poly look (thus improved asthetics and consistency).
[*]Do a complete overhaul of the gameplay: It will be all about finding gnomes. So no story but instead interesting things like gnomes hiding in items and giving away visual clues and you needing to spot them. Also the catching of the gnomes will be changed: they will be hauled away by a steampunk drone with limited capacity to give a natural limit to the amount of gnomes you can catch per second (instead of the fear mechanic).
[*]It will have a rotating camera (as requested)
[/list] 

For a peek at the improved visuals see my latest blog post [url=https://gamefeelings.com/2020/11/25/20-putting-in-the-hours/]https://gamefeelings.com/2020/11/25/20-putting-in-the-hours/[/url]
If you want to get on Discord please feel welcome to add [url=https://discord.gg/5sMsQkQf]https://discord.gg/5sMsQkQf[/url]

And on the new title: This will be a sci-fi themed meshup of the RPG/4X/strategy genres. To follow you can get on [url=https://gamefeelings.com/2020/11/25/20-putting-in-the-hours/]discord[/url], on [url=https://twitter.com/GameFeelings020]twitter[/url], register to my [url=http://eepurl.com/gP_0zT]mailing list[/url], or [url=https://gamefeelings.com/blogs/]read my blogs[/url].

Thanks for the read!
I'm looking forward to hear from you.

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
Here it is. The first update on the gameplay.

In short:
[list]
    [*]More actions by gnomes in front of the camera
    [*]Working of Chaos mechanism redone
    [*]Some other minor gameplay enriching fixes
[/list]

I'm aware of the confusing gameplay some of you are experiencing. I hope to address it with this update and the upcoming updates.

Stay tuned!

If you experience any launchday issues, don't hesitate to post a report on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/810420]the community hub[/url].

    [*]Music
    [*]Final touches
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3.0
notes.content:
On March the 18th 2018, Beta version 0.3.0 did release. 

In short:

[list]
[*]Progress.
[*]Better distinction between the two gamemodus.
[*]Added a couple of variations of the big scene as separate levels.
[*]Overall finishing touches.
[/list]

The next official project update is scheduled at 25 April 2018, we will hit version 0.4 by then. It will add the main-selling feature… what this means is yet to filled in but I know it will be as good as the previous updates!
